text:
Maria Patel: Hey team, Zenith POC reports intermittent JSON parse errors in their browser when using our streaming SSE endpoint — 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. They included a capture.
Alex Kim: can you paste the raw SSE they sent?
Maria Patel: here's the redacted capture:
```
data: {"id":"msg_123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello"}}]

data: {"id":"msg_123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"|col1|col2|\n"}}],"done":true}
```
Maria Patel: second event shows a missing closing brace before the final event.
Jordan Lee: could be upstream close mid-write — ALB/nginx timeouts or model crash. Any gateway logs for session id zn-84321?
DeployBot: [deploy] routed zn-84321 -> model-node-17 at 2026-09-04T15:02:11Z
Samir Gupta: pulling proxy logs... ALB reported a 504 idle close at ~60s for that connection. But customer says responses were <60s.
Alex Kim: also consider client-side reassembly issues; some SSE parsers choke if chunks split oddly. We should avoid splitting single JSON across events.
Jordan Lee: runtime logs show the model process crashed with OOM at token 412 for that request — it exited before sending a proper final event.
Maria Patel: so backend crash explains abrupt truncation. They didn't see errors client-side.
Samir Gupta: patched runtime to reject priming inputs >12k tokens for this plan. I'll enable stream debugging for the route and add x-rw-debug:zn-84321 header to trace token flushes for 1h.
DeployBot: [trace] stream-debug enabled for r-90321 by samir at 2026-09-04T15:12:03Z
Alex Kim: customer asked if Dedicated would help — it might reduce noisy-neighbor OOMs but won't fix middlebox timeouts. Offer a 2-week Dedicated eval credit while we confirm.
Jordan Lee: follow-ups: 1) add watchdog shim in proxy to emit an error event if backend process exits unexpectedly; 2) keep x-rw-debug traces for the session; 3) verify keepalive comment handling through popular CDNs.
Samir Gupta: filed RW-STREAM-612 and attached logs.
Maria Patel: asked customer to run `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams ...` from a home network and send HAR. Also quoted Dedicated trial pricing ($3k credit) and support hours.
Customer (via Maria): will test from home tomorrow and wants Dedicated pricing.
Alex Kim: sales ok with $3k two-week eval credit pending capacity. Maria, send terms.
Maria Patel: will do. Closing after customer confirms curl. :thumbsup:
